fields.note: Faces, core, SiC, PBO and pads are classed calculated, because they are sized by analysis and none are built. Joints, films, seams, sleeves, nodes and primer are classed estimated (rules and catalog areal masses). The finish carries its own +10%; P3's joint allowance above the actual sleeves is its own margin. The 100 kg systems allowance, the vacuum-service charge, gas, contamination, retained water, weather headroom and the sag lift debit get none.
